## Audit: "Rate your visits" — Empty State

**1) Clear title** ✅
"Rate your visits" in bold at top-left with a back arrow — unambiguous and correctly scoped to the screen's purpose.

**2) Empty-state doorway (icon + title + one line)** ✅
All three components present:
- Icon: soft gray circle with a star outline — thematically appropriate (ratings) and visually quiet
- Title: "No completed visits yet" — honest, accurate, no blame
- Support line: "After a visit finishes, it appears here and you can rate the experience." — one concise sentence that sets expectations

**3) Clean layout** ✅
Content block is vertically positioned in the upper third, centered horizontally, with generous whitespace below. Nothing competes for attention; the back affordance is the only escape route, which is appropriate here.

**4) Restrained design** ✅
Monochrome palette (white background, black text, gray accents), single icon, no buttons, no upsells, no decorative clutter. Typography hierarchy (bold heading / muted body) is correct.

**Minor note (non-blocking):** The empty block sits slightly high, leaving a large blank lower half — acceptable, though nudging it toward vertical center could feel more balanced.

**VERDICT: PASS**
